player_prompt.intro:
Jumaxa Player {player_id} uñt'asipxi Pig Dice p'ikt'it. 

Q'awa:
- Turnompi, '[roll]' jan ukax '[hold]' manta
- 2-6 Roll: Turnompi totalman q'uwant'a
- 1 Roll: Turnompi totalman q'ulunta, turnompi tukuyi
- Hold: Turnompi totalman punkunkir scoreman q'uwant'a, turnompi tukuyi
- Nayra {winning_score} puntosman jikxatasi

Turnoma, kunjamsa scores actuals ukat turnompi total uñt'ayata.
'[roll]' jan ukax '[hold]' manta jawirixi.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Q'awa manq'a format. '[roll]' jan ukax '[hold]' manta.

outcome.draw: Uka turnionx mä pachakiw utjxi, ukat taqpach anatirinakax kikipakïpxiwa: {scores}
